text: 纳斯达克金龙中国指数收涨0.27%，报6570.30点，整体低开高走。 热门中概股里，再鼎医药初步收涨13.7%，晶科能源涨2.8%，大全新能源涨2.2%，网易涨1.7%，日月光半导体涨1.4%，阿特斯太阳能涨0.6%，腾讯跌1.3%，阿里跌1.4%。 ETF中，中国科技指数ETF（CQQQ）收涨0.31%，中概互联网指数ETF（KWEB）收跌0.56%。 德银嘉实沪深300指数ETF（ASHR）收涨0.55%，XtrackersHarvest中证50（ASHS）收涨0.34%，MSCI新兴市场ex中国ETF（EMXC）收跌1.21%。
text_en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index closed up 0.27% at 6,570.30 points, opening low and rising overall. Among popular Chinese stocks, Zai Lab initially closed up 13.7%, JinkoSolar up 2.8%, Daqo New Energy up 2.2%, NetEase up 1.7%, ASE Technology up 1.4%, Canadian Solar up 0.6%, Tencent down 1.3%, Alibaba down 1.4%. Among ETFs, the China Technology Index ETF (CQQQ) closed up 0.31%, and the China Internet ETF (KWEB) closed down 0.56%. The Deutsche X-trackers Harvest CSI 300 ETF (ASHR) closed up 0.55%, Xtrackers Harvest CSI 50 (ASHS) closed up 0.34%, and the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF (EMXC) closed down 1.21%.
